ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:18 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) field with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal lateral tips. Sparse, high-contrast focal points (mottling) are distributed medially on both lobes, with a distinct vertical high-intensity streak along the midline/peduncle axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth reaching roughly 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations on the left trailing edge; right trailing edge exhibits higher-amplitude, jagged peaks (4-5 distinct valleys) near the distal tip, isolated from the high-contrast background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the inner trailing margins, transitioning to a sharp convex trajectory at the distal lateral boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast ring-like clusters (rosettes) approximately 5-8 units, predominantly localized in the lower-central and mid-left lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense collection of multi-directional, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the left lobe, with sparse diagonal linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy textural buildup and irregular high-intensity pigmentation on the terminal edges of both lobes, indicating significant prior trauma or localized colonization marks.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, singular vertical high-intensity linear feature extending from the insertion point toward the median notch.
